You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0223.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D

rw=Chem.RWMol()
# Atom label / coordinates in image pixels, coordinates converted with y negated
coords=[
 ('C',262,208), #0 benz fusion A
 ('C',190,304), #1 benz fusion B
 ('C',70,295), #2
 ('C',20,184), #3
 ('C',91,86), #4
 ('C',210,101), #5
 ('C',374,244), #6 G
 ('C',374,364), #7 H
 ('N',260,382), #8 indole NH
 ('C',480,187), #9 J
 ('N',580,140), #10 tertiary
 ('C',328,95), #11
 ('C',478,20), #12
 ('C',548,90), #13
 ('C',583,244), #14 O
 ('C',583,365), #15 P
 ('C',480,425), #16 Q
 ('C',687,184), #17 R
 ('C',687,305), #18 S
 ('C',787,365), #19 T
 ('C',480,515), #20 ester carbonyl
 ('O',430,565), #21 carbonyl O
 ('O',545,515), #22 ester single O
 ('C',610,550), #23 methoxy methyl
 ('C',790,455), #24 Me substituent
 ('O',855,325), #25 OH oxygen
 # explicit stereochemical H's
 ('H',445,124), #26 on J
 ('H',625,415), #27 on P
 ('H',740,267), #28 on S
]
for sym,x,y in coords:
    rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(sym))
# bonds
bonds=[
 (0,1,Chem.BondType.AROMATIC),(1,2,Chem.BondType.AROMATIC),(2,3,Chem.BondType.AROMATIC),(3,4,Chem.BondType.AROMATIC),(4,5,Chem.BondType.AROMATIC),(5,0,Chem.BondType.AROMATIC),
 (0,6,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(1,8,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(8,7,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(7,6,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),
 (6,9,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(6,11,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(11,12,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(12,13,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(13,10,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(10,9,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),
 (9,14,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(14,15,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(15,16,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(16,7,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE),
 (10,17,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(17,18,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(18,15,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(18,19,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),
 (16,20,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(20,21,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE),(20,22,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(22,23,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(19,24,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(19,25,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),
 (9,26,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(15,27,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(18,28,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),
]
for a,b,t in bonds: rw.AddBond(a,b,t)
m=rw.GetMol()
# mark aromatics
for i in range(6): m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).SetIsAromatic(True)
# wedge indicated bonds from stereocenter start to explicit ligand
for a,b,d in [(9,26,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH),(15,27,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH),(18,28,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH),(19,25,Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE)]:
    m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(a,b).SetBondDir(d)
# coordinates conformer for chiral perception
conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for i,(_,x,y) in enumerate(coords): conf.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(float(x),float(-y),0.0))
m.AddConformer(conf)
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(m, replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, cleanIt=True, force=True)
print('chiral')
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 if a.GetChiralTag()!=Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED:
  print(a.GetIdx(),a.GetSymbol(),a.GetChiralTag(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '?')
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
# remove wedge bond dirs irrelevant and add remaining Hs
for b in m.GetBonds(): b.SetBondDir(Chem.BondDir.NONE)
m=Chem.AddHs(m, addCoords=True)
# embed using existing tags, starting conformer not actually suitable, clear conformers
m.RemoveAllConformers()
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); p.randomSeed=223; p.useRandomCoords=False
res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,p)
print('embed',res)
if res<0:
 p.useRandomCoords=True; print(AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,p))
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=1000)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('final stereo')
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 if a.GetChiralTag()!=Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED:
  print(a.GetIdx(),a.GetSymbol(),a.GetChiralTag(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '?')
conf=m.GetConformer()
with open('/root/answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\nGenerated from mol_0223.png\n')
 for a in m.GetAtoms():
  p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
  f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}\n')
PY
